data.name: Airline Ops
data.detailed_description:
AIRLINE OPS

Two ways to play. One obsession.

SIMPLE MODE Launch flights with one click. Batch-dispatch your entire fleet. Enable auto-repeat and watch the money roll in. Build fast, expand everywhere.

SIMULATION MODE (Coming Post-Launch) Preflight checklists. Crew assignments. Fuel calculations. Every flight is hands-on. Faster path to Elite Operator Status — plus exclusive cosmetics and prestige badges for those who earn it the hard way.

EARLY ACCESS LAUNCH Simple Mode ships first. Simulation Mode is coming — we're building it based on community feedback. Your input shapes the final product.

THE WORLD 4,878 airports across every continent. Real-time weather affects your operations. Watch your planes move across a live global map — or crank time compression to 32x and speed-run your empire.

AIRCRAFT 373+ unique aircraft types at launch.

ELITE OPERATOR STATUS EOS can't be bought. It's earned:

  • Tier 5 reputation

  • 85%+ on-time performance

  • Zero cancellations

  • Positive cash flow

  • 14 consecutive qualifying days

THE GOLD A380 Once you earn EOS, the EOS Store unlocks. Buy the Gold A380 and roll for a collectible aircraft:

RarityChanceRare79.9%Relic10%Anomalous5%Legendary5%Mythic0.1%

98 collectible aircraft in the EOS Store. Aviation history. Engineering marvels. And some things that probably shouldn't exist.

THE MYTHIC 0.1% chance. When it drops, everyone knows. Global leaderboard recognition. Rewards that match the rarity. There can only be one.

KEY FEATURES

  • Two game modes — Simple for empire builders, Simulation for ops purists (Simulation coming post-launch)

  • 4,878 real airports — Global coverage, every continent

  • Real-time operations — Watch your fleet fly across a live map

  • Live weather — Real-world weather affects your flights

  • Free time compression — 1x to 32x

  • 98 collectible aircraft — Chase the collection

  • Deep systems — Routes, reputation, hubs, and more

TECHNOLOGY SYSTEMS (Coming Soon)

  • CrewWise — AI-powered crew management

  • WebLogic — Route optimization

  • YieldMaster — Dynamic pricing

  • MaintenancePro — Fleet maintenance tracking

IN-GAME ECONOMY You can purchase currency to acquire aircraft faster. But owning a plane doesn't mean you can fly it. No reputation? Grounded. Wrong tier? It waits. Money buys assets. Progression earns access. Your airline. Your way.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-7400 or AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 960 / AMD Radeon R9 380 or equivalent with 2 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Designed for 1080p displays. Performance scales with simulation size and active routes.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-8700 or AMD Ryzen 7 3700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1660 / AMD Radeon RX 5600 XT or equivalent with 6 GB VRAM
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: Any DirectX-compatible sound card
  • VR Support: Not supported
  • Additional Notes: Recommended for large airline networks, higher simulation speeds, and extended play sessions.
